scope: Current revised plan only; narration rewritten 2026-11-16 into one continuous commentary script; no factual claim changed
limitations: Fictional faces, interiors, clothing and movements are dramatization
Dream argument attributed to accused, not victim-blaming
No exact unverified event times or driving transport claims
He admitted only in interrogation on 4 Jan; the narration no longer implies an earlier admission
No method, quantity or body-disposal detail in narration; victim is not framed as the cause
Narration assigns responsibility to the perpetrator; the closing question is reflection, not indictment of the family
visual_revision_note: S28 judge-only staging; remove duplicated foreground youth. No narration or verified fact changes.

narration_wording_revision.before: 他关上房门，也把真相留在了屋里。后来，他承认杀害妹妹。
narration_wording_revision.after: 他关上房门，也把真相留在了屋里。后来，他承认，妹妹的死与自己有关。
narration_wording_revision.reason: Speech content moderation refused the sentence naming the killing; user approved this minimal rewrite in advance and picked this wording.
narration_wording_revision.fact_basis: He shut the door and later admitted that his sister’s death was connected to him. No new claim, no changed chronology, no mitigation of responsibility; only the graphic verb is removed.
narration_wording_revision.approved_by: user decision 2026-11-16 (option: 后来，他承认，妹妹的死与自己有关。)

narration_rewrite_2026_11_16.reason: User verdict: previous 30 lines read as detached captions — incoherent, illogical, incomplete, no film-commentary voice.
narration_rewrite_2026_11_16.approach: One chronological through-line: cold open (31 Dec arrival) → rewind to 30 Dec family and departures → the argument (attributed to his statement) → the killing behind the door → concealment and the camp → return, discovery, arrest → responsibility hearings and the two sentences → reflection.
narration_rewrite_2026_11_16.fact_effect: No new factual claim. The old S12 placed 'he later admitted' at 67s, which broke chronology; the admission now sits at S23 with the interrogation. Dream quarrel still only as his statement. No method/body-disposal detail. Two-instance judgment and appeal reasoning unchanged.
narration_rewrite_2026_11_16.duration_effect: New script 536 Han characters (~5% shorter than the 565-character version); expected atempo well under the 1.55 limit.
narration_rewrite_2026_11_16.voice: voice-00 unchanged; all 30 clips re-recorded, ASR-verified and re-reviewed before render.
narration_rewrite_2026_11_16.s12_wording_exception: The previously approved S12 wording is no longer used verbatim; the new S12 makes a weaker statement (he shut the door and left the truth inside). This removes wording, it does not add a claim.
narration_rewrite_2026_11_16.s29_punctuation: S29 在「责任」后加逗号，只改停顿不改词；ASR 对连读的『责任在施暴者』失误，先靠停顿修正，未降级措辞。

s09_bridge.why: User: jumping from 「家里只剩兄妹两人」 straight to 「据他后来的供述」 is abrupt and pushes the viewer out of the story.
before: S09 据他后来的供述，争执中，妹妹谈到了自己的梦想。
S10 他说，她讲了一句：你没有梦想。
after: S09 门里再没有第三个人。之后的经过，只有他的说法。
S10 他说，争执中，她讲了一句：你没有梦想。
s09_bridge.fact_effect: No new claim: the house held only the two of them, and the quarrel still exists only as his statement. The bridge names the evidential status instead of presenting the quarrel as observed fact.
s09_bridge.responsibility: The rebuttal remains in S29 (责任，在施暴者), and the 49–55s explainer still says the quarrel comes from the accused and does not shift blame to the victim.

names_instead_of_pronouns.why: User: the narration keeps saying 他/她, so viewers who only listen cannot tell who did what.
names_instead_of_pronouns.change: Every ambiguous pronoun is replaced by 勇贵 (the accused) or 亚澄 (his sister); the mother is named by role 母亲, the elder brother by 长子. 勇贵/亚澄 are the dramatization pseudonyms already used by the project, not verified real names, so the on-screen disclaimer now says 人物为化名.
names_instead_of_pronouns.fact_effect: Wording only. No new claim, no change of chronology, no change of who did what.
names_instead_of_pronouns.rate_note: The 15th line was the fastest measured segment (4.37 Hanzi/s vs a 3.3-3.8 median); it is now two sentences so the date gets its own beat, and the other dense lines gained a pause.
